Given that L{tn}=n!sn+1,s>0, use linearity of Laplace transforms and the first shifting theorem to find the Laplace transform of f(t)=e4t+5t3e−t for s>4.

a
1s−4+30(s−1)4
b
1s−4+30(s+1)4
c
1s+4+30(s+1)4
d
1s−4+6(s+1)4
e
4s−4+30(s+1)4
